evals.name: analyze-5-tickets
evals.prompt: analyze the last 5 completed tickets and identify improvement opportunities
evals.expected_output: Learning report with token efficiency metrics, success rate analysis, and skill improvement proposals

assertions.text: Analyzed at least 5 completed tickets from .claude/workflows/tickets/done/
Calculated token efficiency metrics (estimated vs actual)
Measured success rate (passed first attempt / total validated)
Identified 2-5 improvement opportunities
Provided actionable skill improvement proposals
Generated learning report in .claude/workflows/learning/reports/
Updated metrics.json with learning analysis

evals.name: pattern-recognition
evals.prompt: identify patterns in recent ticket execution and suggest specific skill improvements
evals.expected_output: Pattern analysis with concrete skill update recommendations

assertions.text: Read and analyzed ticket execution metadata (timing, token usage, success)
Identified recurring patterns (common failures, inefficiencies, bottlenecks)
Mapped patterns to specific skill improvement opportunities
Provided concrete skill update recommendations with expected impact
Prioritized improvements by impact vs effort
Documented patterns in .claude/workflows/learning/patterns/

evals.name: skill-improvement-proposal
evals.prompt: based on recent workflow performance, generate a skill improvement proposal with A/B testing plan
evals.expected_output: Detailed improvement proposal with evaluation methodology

assertions.text: Analyzed workflow metrics to identify improvement opportunity
Generated specific skill improvement proposal (which skill, what change)
Defined success criteria for improvement (metrics to track)
Created A/B testing plan (test cases, with-skill vs without-skill)
Estimated expected impact (time, tokens, success rate)
Provided implementation steps and rollback plan
Documented proposal in structured format
